entities.name: House Verdenth
entities.description: One of five powerful houses of Arathoxia, ruled by Lady Verdenth from Krysalthus.

entities.name: Lady Verdenth
entities.description: Green mana sorceress and mistress of House Verdenth, killed by Ravidel.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Infant saved by Lady Verdenth from wolves.

entities.name: Ezer
entities.description: Rushed the infant Jared away from the Battle of Aster Fall.

entities.name: Marshall Bikov
entities.description: Ally of Lady Verdenth during Ravidel's invasion.

entities.name: Planar Barge
entities.description: Vessel whose blast obliterated Verdenth's castle.

entities.name: Krysalthus
entities.description: Forest from which House Verdenth ruled.

events.summary: Ravidel invades Arathoxia and destroys House Verdenth, killing Lady Verdenth in a personal duel.
events.quote: House Verdenth was destroyed in Ravidel’s invasion of Arathoxia, and the Lady herself was killed in a personal duel with Ravidel.

events.summary: Lady Verdenth saves the infant Jared Carthalion from wolves.
events.quote: She saved the infant Jared Carthalion in Krysalthus from wolves as Ezer rushed the baby away from the Battle of Aster Fall .
